source: Official pricing page https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, verified 2026-10-29 (cache read multiplier: Fable 5.1 / Mythos 5.1 0.025x, Opus/Sonnet 5.5 0.05x, others 0.1x; Claude 4.6+ models except Haiku 5.5 have no long-context premium; Haiku 5.5 is priced per request by prompt length, over 100k prompt tokens x5 on every field). Update this file when prices or models change and note the date here.
local_change: Do not edit per machine: put overrides in ~/.claude/cost/prices.json (same layout, only the models you change; replaces entries by model key) or point COST_PRICES to a file.
unit: USD per 1M tokens; the model id is matched by PREFIX (longest prefix wins). A model that matches nothing is unpriced: its cost counts as 0 and its tokens are reported as 'unpriced'. writing_multiplier = cache write price as a multiple of the input price (5-minute and 1-hour cache). long_prompt_threshold / long_prompt_multiplier = prompt-size threshold and price multiplier for long prompts.
